I wonder if forgetting a birthday is a big deal. I mean, some people might not mind, but others might feel neglected. In this case, my girlfriend did feel neglected, so it's a problem. In terms of personal growth, maybe this experience can teach me to be more attentive in the future. It's a lesson in prioritizing and remembering what's important to my partner. In this case, it led to a breakup, so it's something I need to take seriously and learn from.
